The SC777 V4 has 2x 25GbE onboard ports. The ports are connected to an onboard NVIDIA ConnectX-6 Lx
controller, implemented with SFP28 cages for optical or copper connections. Supports 1Gb, 10Gb and 25Gb
connections. Locations of these ports is shown in the Components and connectors section.
25GbE Port 1 supports NC-SI for remote management. For factory orders, to specify which ports should
have NC-SI enabled, use the feature codes listed in the Remote Management section. If neither is chosen,
both ports will have NC-SI disabled by default.
For the specifci ations of the 25GbE ports including the supported transceivers and cables, see the
ConnectX-6 Lx product guide:
